sources.title: [2510.08600v1] Recover-LoRA: Data-Free Accuracy Recovery of Degraded ...
sources.snippet: In this work, we propose Recover-LoRA, a lightweight and dataset agnostic method to recover accuracy in degraded models. Recover-LoRA uses synthetic data and logit distillation to learn LoRA adapters on selective layers that facilitate aligning the degraded model to its full precision model.
